description:
Flight planning software for pilots.

SkyDemon Plan provides flight-planning features for pilots on Windows.
- Waypoints and airspace applicable only to gliders is now shown only when you have selected a glider (iOS, Android, PC)
  Previously, there was an option under the Mapping menu to control visibility of glider-specific entities. Now, selecting a glider (including the new Simple Glider) as your aircraft controls the visibility automatically.
